What's Changed

  • fix(inputnumber): Hitting enter when text is selected deletes text by @jaroban in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1563
  • fix(autocomplete): use selected item template in single mode by @xonaib in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1398
  • fix(cascadeselect): bind role="group" on nested option lists by @jase88 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1568
  • feat(autocomplete): add generic typing support for AutoComplete compo… by @pavankjadda in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1576
  • fix: #19485 - Table virtualScroll rows not visible with percentage scrollHeight by @karoc123 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1232
  • fix(confirmpopup): resolve options from the active confirmation by @rene-schakmann in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1564
  • fix(scroller): blank rows when lazy loading while scrolling backward or jumping multiple pages by @rgroenewoudt in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1240
  • fix(tooltip): ignore mouseenter that follows no mouseleave by @rene-schakmann in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1442
  • fix: Table ColumnFilter leaves stale ZIndexUtils entries on close by @EeneeS in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1357
  • fix(tooltip): reset escaped content without innerHTML by @jase88 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1418
  • feat(types): export the severity types by @jase88 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1452
  • fix(autocomplete): match options against the model when optionValue is set by @dominicbachmann in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1608
  • fix(dynamicdialog): respect ariaLabelledBy from config by @jase88 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1614
  • fix(treeselect): realign overlay when virtual scroll settles by @Balabk5 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1602
  • fix(schematics): fail ng-add on a PrimeNG workspace instead of warning by @rene-schakmann in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1610
  • refactor(optimus-ui): migrate templates to built-in control flow by @dominicbachmann in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1609
  • fix(theme): stop colorScheme defaults from overriding top-level prese… by @Balabk5 in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1606
  • fix(tabs): Add missing display: flex by @jaroban in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1619
  • fix: mark library-internal ngModel bindings as standalone (NG01354) by @rgroenewoudt in https://github.com/openng-org/optimus-ui/pull/1612
